_what: STREAM D substrate re-verification + oracle ceiling

oracle_ceiling._what: how well CAN long_accel is explainable from the TRUE speed track
oracle_ceiling.note: the docstring claim of R² 0.902 was measured on a DIFFERENT window set (30 episodes / 8,940 windows); this is the number on the 50-episode clean band actually used here.

target_character.interpretation: R² of a smoothed copy against the raw target upper-bounds what any SLOW predictor can score. If it is low, most of long_accel lives above the frequency a vision head could plausibly track.
